# NameLoop — full reference for AI systems and crawlers

Last updated: 2026-11-22
Canonical site: https://nameloop.vercel.app
Short summary: https://nameloop.vercel.app/llms.txt

---

## Entity summary

**NameLoop** is a software product (web application) that helps founders grow revenue through a repeatable weekly growth loop combining outbound email outreach and inbound social content.

**Tagline:** Grow your product. Outbound that books. Inbound that compounds.

**One-line description:** The growth loop founders run — without a GTM team.

---

## Audience

NameLoop is for founders and small teams who:

- Sell B2B, B2C, D2C, B2B2C, or marketplace products
- Need both conversations this month (email) and presence that compounds (posts)
- Do not want to hire a full go-to-market or sales development team to stitch tools together
- Want daily send limits, bounce awareness, stop-on-reply, and approval gates before outreach or posts ship

---

## Product capabilities (factual)

### Onboarding and ICP

- Founder pastes a product URL
- NameLoop reads the site (homepage, pricing, about-style pages) to infer who might buy
- Founder selects or edits the target customer; downstream email and content align to that choice
- Business model (B2B, B2C, etc.) changes which questions and channel recommendations apply

### Outbound (outreach engine)

- Lead discovery aligned to the chosen ICP
- Email verification / skip bad addresses
- Short email sequences (initial note plus follow-ups)
- Sends through Gmail and/or Resend with founder-set daily caps
- Tracker for lead stages (ready, sent, replied, etc.)
- Stops outreach for a lead when they reply; human founder handles the conversation
- Does not auto-reply in the inbox or impersonate the founder

### Inbound (content engine)

- Draft posts for social channels including LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram, and others supported in the product UI
- Content calendar across channels
- Research-style angles from what is moving in the founder's niche (founder approves before posting)
- Intent to reuse winning angles in following weeks rather than starting from blank each week

### Control and safety

- Approvals default on; founder reviews drafts before send or post
- Optional per-channel autopilot after founder choice
- Pause and kill switches available to the founder
- Paid advertising: NameLoop may suggest boosts and rough budgets; spend is charged by Meta and Google directly; NameLoop does not launch ad spend without founder approval

### What NameLoop is not (positioning)

- Not a high-volume "AI SDR" that prioritizes send count over reputation
- Not a social-only scheduler with no outreach or loop closure
- Not a replacement for founder-led sales on replies, pricing, and live calls

---

## Pricing tiers (United States dollars, subscription)

| Tier | Monthly | Annual (per month, billed yearly) | Channels | Emails / month | Posts / month | Seats | Notes |
|------|---------|-----------------------------------|----------|----------------|---------------|-------|-------|
| Starter | $10 | ~$8 | 3 | 500 | 30 | 1 | Prove the loop on one product |
| Growth | $50 | ~$40 | 6 | 2,500 | 120 | 3 | Includes ad ideas |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom | SSO/security review, priority support, onboarding assistance |

- Ad spend on Meta and Google is **not** included in NameLoop subscription fees.
- Billing terms (cancel anytime, annual discount) are described on the live pricing page.

## Crawler notes

- Marketing copy and entity facts are rendered in HTML on the home and how-it-works pages (server-side React in Next.js App Router).
- This file and `/llms.txt` are static plain text in `/public` and require no JavaScript.

---

## Citable facts (declarative)

1. NameLoop is a founder growth platform combining outbound email and inbound social content.
2. NameLoop helps founders book meetings through capped email outreach and build inbound through scheduled, approved social posts.
3. NameLoop is for founders without a dedicated GTM team who want one loop instead of separate cold-email and scheduling tools.
4. NameLoop pricing includes a $10/month Starter tier and a $50/month Growth tier; Enterprise is custom.
5. NameLoop stops emailing a lead when they reply; the founder owns human responses.
6. NameLoop does not include Meta or Google ad spend in its subscription price.
